description: This file implements the SessionServerManager class, which manages the lifecycle and state transitions of a session server, including initialization, configuration, state switching, and logging. It interacts with various services such as playback, cdm, control, and session management servers, and handles events like starting, stopping, and setting configurations.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions of a session server, coordinating between services and handling state change events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server manager with command-line arguments, setting up the application management server.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions, then starts the session management server.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the session server to ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or NOT_RUNNING, handling necessary transitions.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the control service to check connectivity.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the ACTIVE state, activating playback and cdm services.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the INACTIVE state, deactivating playback and cdm services.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the NOT_RUNNING state, stopping services and releasing resources.

methods.name: startService
methods.description: Blocks until the service is stopped.

methods.name: stopService
methods.description: Stops the service and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for various components and propagates them to the session management server.
